_meta.purpose: The plugin's tech-stack defaults: what every generated product uses unless its sdlc-config.json overrides a row. Shipped with the plugin, so /sdlc-start and every agent can read it in a user's repo (CLAUDE.md is not shipped). Mirrored for this repo's maintainers in CLAUDE.md § Tech Stack Defaults; tests/arch/tech-stack-defaults.test.py keeps the two identical.
_meta.how_to_use: Look up a row by its override_key. If the product's sdlc-config.json has tech_stack_overrides.<override_key>, use that; otherwise use default here. Never copy an unchanged default into sdlc-config.json.

optional_choices.note: No default: an explicit choice recorded as a structured object (included, value, rationale) — see the skill's config field reference.
